name: Whisparr Sync
description: Connects Cove to the Whisparr instance you configure, calling outward to it over the network and authenticating with the API key you supply. Its settings tab tests a connection, reports which Whisparr generation answered, keeps each generation's connection separately, and registers Cove's import callback in the instance. Nothing is imported yet: the callback checks a delivery and acknowledges it. It exposes inbound API endpoints under /api/extensions/com.alextomas955.whisparrsync. All but one are gated on a Cove permission. The single exception is the import callback at /api/extensions/com.alextomas955.whisparrsync/callback, which answers anonymously because the caller is Whisparr rather than a Cove user; it is authenticated instead by a secret this extension mints and stores server-side, and a request that does not present it is refused. Only actions you start can cause Whisparr to download anything. Your Whisparr API key is held server-side in Cove and is never sent to the browser. Runs no scraper and no downloader code of its own.
author: alextomas955
